LESSON: INSPIRED WORD OF GOD

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible
Topic 2.1: Inspired Word of God

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Inspired Word of God. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is the Bible different from other books?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain why the Bible is the inspired word of God
2. name three authors who wrote the Bible
3. discuss reasons that led to translation of the Bible into local languages

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. explain why the Bible is the inspired word of God
   In simple words: practise until you can explain why the Bible is the inspired word of God. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. name three authors who wrote the Bible
   In simple words: practise until you can name three authors who wrote the Bible. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. discuss reasons that led to translation of the Bible into local languages
   In simple words: practise until you can discuss reasons that led to translation of the Bible into local languages. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Inspired Word of God using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Inspired Word of God in the examples.
2. Explain Inspired Word of God to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Inspired Word of God.
4. Show that you can: explain why the Bible is the inspired word of God

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Inspired Word of God using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Inspired Word of God important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Compose and sing a song on ‘the Bible as an inspired Word of God’,
2. Read 2 Timothy 3:16-17 and explain the meaning of the text,
3. Imagination and creativity: the skill of originality is enhanced as learners compose and sing a song on, ‘The Bible as an inspired Word of God’.
4. Creative Arts: creative skills are applied as learners compose and sing a song on, ‘The Bible as an inspired Word of God.’

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain why the Bible is the inspired word of God
2. name three authors who wrote the Bible
3. discuss reasons that led to translation of the Bible into local languages

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
